info.title: Deja API
info.description: Incident copilot with institutional memory (Neo4j). Contract is frozen: see docs/API_CONTRACT.md

schema.title: Response Similar Incidents Insights Similar Incidents Get
Response Fix Stats Insights Fix Stats Get
Response Timeline Incidents  Incident Id  Timeline Get

post.description: Clears short-term chat state only. Graph memory is untouched - that is the point of the demo.

post.summary: Stress-test incident diagnosis via counterfactual evidence perturbation
post.description: Simulates removal of evidence items or entire evidence source channels. Calculates before/after scores, margin, and verdict (robust | fragile | inconclusive) using tie epsilon 0.25 without arbitrary tie-breaking. All scores are heuristic, not a probability.

get.summary: Retrieve ranked candidate hypotheses and supporting evidence items for an incident
get.description: Returns candidates with upstream hops, scores, and deterministic evidence items. All scores are heuristic, not a probability.

verdict.description: Verdict: robust (top suspect holds), fragile (top suspect flips), or inconclusive (tie within epsilon 0.25)

margin_before.title: Margin Before

margin_after.title: Margin After
margin_after.description: Score difference between #1 and #2 after perturbation (heuristic, not a probability). Null if fewer than two suspects exist.
